short_summary: Vista Do Sol Centre: no distinct official website found -- only aggregator/directory listings (Tiendeo, Cylex) and one tenant (Steers) turned up via search, none confirming a dedicated centre site. Likely a small/single-anchor centre. Skipped, no changes.

Eco Park: discovered Eco Boulevard shopping centre (own site ecoboulevard.co.za) and added 3 verified tenants -- Beyond Bowling, Checkers Eco Boulevard, Virgin Active Eco Park -- each with a phone and address from two agreeing directory sources. Discarded Wing Wah Sushi, Mehak Indian Restaurant and So-cie-tea: found in the mall but couldn't pin an explicitly-stated phone number to them.
